mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.doctorName}, '%')
AND s.visit_date = #{query.date}
AND s.status = '停诊'
AND s.status != '停诊' AND TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
AND s.status != '停诊' AND TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s.remain_count = 0
AND s.status != '停诊' AND TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s.remain_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5
AND s.status != '停诊' AND TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s.remain_count > 5
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_sources, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_count), 0) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.remain_count), 0) AS remain_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status != '停诊' AND TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s.remain_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS low_remain FROM source s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id

SELECT s.id AS source_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department, s.visit_date, s.time_period, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.total_count, s.remain_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a2 WHERE a2.source_id = s.id AND a2.status <> '取消') AS booked_count, CASE WHEN s.status = '停诊' THEN '已停诊' WHEN TIMESTAMP(s.visit_date, s.end_time) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN '已结束' WHEN s.remain_count = 0 THEN '已约满' WHEN s.remain_count <= 5 THEN '低余量' ELSE '正常' END AS status FROM source s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id
ORDER BY s.visit_date DESC, s.start_time ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, s.visit_date, s.time_period, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.total_count, s.remain_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a2 WHERE a2.source_id = s.id AND a2.status <> '取消') AS booked_count, s.status, s.suspension_reason FROM source s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id WHERE s.id = #{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE source SET visit_date = #{visitDate}, time_period = #{timePeriod}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, total_count = #{totalCount}, remain_count = #{remainCount} WHERE id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'SOURCE_ADJUST', 'UPDATE', 'SOURCE', #{sourceId}, LEFT(#{target}, 100), #{reason}, '成功' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS source_id, d.name AS doctor_name, s.visit_date, s.time_period, s.status AS source_status, s.total_count, s.remain_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status NOT IN ('取消', '已完成') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS affected_appointment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '待支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已签到' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS signed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '接诊中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_consultation_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '退款中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refunding_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimated_refund_count, CASE WHEN s.status = '停诊' THEN FALSE WHEN s.visit_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN FALSE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('已签到', '接诊中', '退款中') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS can_suspend, CASE WHEN s.status = '停诊' THEN '该号源已经停诊' WHEN s.visit_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN '已结束的号源不能停诊' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '接诊中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN '存在接诊中的患者，需要人工处理' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已签到' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN '存在已签到患者，需要人工处理' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '退款中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN '存在退款中的预约，请先完成退款处理' ELSE NULL END AS blocked_reason FROM source s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN appointment a ON a.source_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{sourceId} GROUP BY s.id, d.name, s.visit_date, s.time_period, s.status, s.total_count, s.remain_count
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND status NOT IN ('取消', '已完成')

SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, p.user_id AS recipient_user_id, a.status, pay.id AS payment_id, pay.amount AS payment_amount, pay.status AS payment_status FROM appointment a INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN payment pay ON pay.appointment_id = a.id WHERE a.source_id = #{sourceId} AND a.status NOT IN ('取消', '已完成') ORDER BY a.id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = '取消' WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND status = '待支付'
UPDATE appointment SET status = '退款中' WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND status = '已支付'
UPDATE payment p INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = p.appointment_id SET p.status = '已关闭' WHERE a.source_id = #{sourceId} AND a.status = '取消' AND p.status = '待支付'

UPDATE source SET status = #{status}, suspension_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = '停诊' THEN #{reason} ELSE NULL END, suspension_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = '停诊' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, suspended_by = CASE WHEN #{status} = '停诊' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{sourceId}
